title: F#@K I Love U
description: F#@k I Love U is a dramatic tale of a modern family that gets quickly pulled into a spiral of interconnected events that test the limits of their bond and mutual love. Douglas Winston is, by all appearances, the perfect family man. A well groomed and successful black politician, he, his wife white Angie, and their two sons, James and Michael, seem to lead idyllic lives that quickly begin to unravel when Douglas visits his brother J, an white irresponsible would be actor with heavy drug and sex habits. After a jeopardizing incident endangers all of their lives, Douglas is quick to blame J and his irresponsible nature, but in trying to delve into the actual truth, the strands that hold his life together quickly start to unravel into a downward spiral of twisted connections, tangled love, and intrigue that will put to the test the true limits of his faith in those he loves and who he believes in.

title: Vice, nawindang sa Miss Q&A! Nanawagan sa DepEd!
description:
Salubungin ang July with champion biritan kasama nina TNT Duets 2 champs Christian Tbayan at Arvery Lagoring. Nagkaisa naman ang mga 'accla' sa Miss Q and A segment. Ang kanilang chika, bawasan ang problema at dagdagan ang saya. Ipinanalo nina Pia Cayetatayno, Mama Dhel, at Samaya Jhay ang protesta kontra bad vibes.

Isa-isang inilatag ng mga kandidata ang mga paandar nilang intro, drawing laughter from the Madlang People in the studio. Si Vice Ganda, may napansin sa tatlong kandidata. Kung si Pia ay may mga matang ala Meryll Soriano, si Mama Dhel naman daw ay mukhang 'baby' na 36 years overdue.

Nang magsimula ang unang round, ang nasabi na lang ni Meme ay, "Diyos ko!" dahil sa sagot ng mga kandidata for today's video. Sa tanong na, "Ano ang plural ng salitang furniture?" sumagot ang isang kandidata, na para bang sure na sure, "Super furnitures."

Kaya si Meme, 'nanginig' at nag-react nang pabiro, "Nananawagan talaga kami sa Department of Education. Gumalaw na tayo."

Sina Mama Dhel at Samaya Jhay ang nagharap sa ikalawang round, Wit Lang. Ang pinusuan ng mga hurado ay si Mama Dhel bilang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra sa araw na 'to.

Pumuti man ang kanilang buhok, nananatili namang makulay ang sense of humor ng mga beloved lolo't lola from Meycauayan, Bulacan na nakisaya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Mga 'veterans' as in veterans sa pagpapatawa naman ang nagsama-sama sa You Gotta Lyric round na bagong inaabangan ng "It's Showtime" fans. Madlang People ay napa-wow nang si Vice Ganda ay lumabas bilang MemeRimar! Aww!

Ang happy ending sa kuwentong 'to ay para kay Tatay Philip, na umabante sa dulo ng laro. Positive lang ang pananaw ni tatay sa buhay. Aniya, pumunta siya sa "It's Showtime" nang walang dala, kaya aalis siyang sapat na ang P30,000 na Li-Pot offer.

#JulyNaShowtime
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: The S from Hell
description: THE S FROM HELL is a short documentary-cum-horror film about the scariest corporate symbol in history - The 1964 Screen Gems logo, aka 'The S From Hell.' Built around interviews with survivors still traumatized from their childhood exposure to the logo after shows like Bewitched or The Monkees, the film brings their stories to life with animation, found footage, and dramatic reenactments. Not an exhaustive historical documentary, THE S FROM HELL is a subjective film whose aim is make the audience feel the same fear and confusion as the children who were first confronted by the vexing, unfolding sights and mournful, dissonant sounds that hid in the cracks between their favorite TV shows.

title: Pus$y Catz
description: Pus$y Catz follows Lena, Toya, and Semone-three young women navigating survival, ambition, and temptation in the unforgiving streets of Atlanta. When a plan to secure fast money goes wrong, friendships fracture, secrets surface, and dangerous men close in from every direction. As betrayal brews within their own circle, each woman is forced to choose between loyalty, love, and the desperate fight to protect her future. What begins as hustle turns into a high-stakes war of trust, power, and consequences. As the women push deeper into a high-stakes hustle that promises fast cash, their world quickly becomes a maze of scams gone wrong, toxic relationships, manipulation, and revenge. A shady figure from Lena's past reappears, Toya's choices draw unwanted attention, and Semone's loyalty is tested on all sides. The trio begins to fracture, with each woman caught in the crossfire of decisions they can't take back. The tension reaches a breaking point when a setup turns violent, exposing hidden alliances, buried grudges, and a truth that threatens to destroy their bond forever. In a final confrontation where reputations, relationships, and lives hang in the balance, the women must decide: Will they claw their way out together, or tear each other apart? Pus$y Catz Bratz is a gritty, stylish blend of urban drama, betrayal thriller, and character-driven storytelling-where every choice has a cost, and every secret has claws.

description: An exotic dancer with financial problems accepts a job as a nanny in a mansion in La Dehesa.

title: Cenar, escapar y ¡catástrofe!
description: Joyce Pike lleva a su suegra Grace al lujoso restaurante de su esposo, que ella financió, y descubre que sirven comida precocida. Al buscar justicia, es humillada por la amante de su marido, pero Joyce está lista para contraatacar.

title: [Doblado]Venganza y Redención
description: Un día, de camino a casa, Isabella descubrió que su marido Luis estaba teniendo sexo con su hermanastra Caroline en el coche. Así que decidió vengarse de Luis. Con la ayuda de su mejor amiga, se acercó a Adrián, el mejor amigo de Luis y también su rival...

title: [doblado]Cenar, escapar y ¡catástrofe!
description: Sofía Navarro lleva a su suegra, Wanda Soler, a cenar al nuevo y lujoso restaurante de su esposo, Francisco Serrano. Sin embargo, descubre que la comida es precocinada y, al intentar reclamar, es humillada por la amante de su marido. La tragedia se desata cuando la amante causa la muerte de la suegra, dejando a Sofía destrozada y con sed de venganza. Lo que nadie sospecha es que Sofía es la verdadera dueña de todo. Finalmente, logra llevar a los culpables ante la justicia y comienza una nueva vida.

title: Regresó y lo tomó todo
description: Adrián creció en un entorno marginal y violento. A los 20 años huyó de su padre adoptivo y a los 23 regresó a la poderosa familia Ribera. Rodeado de padres parciales, una hermana arrogante y un falso heredero, comprende que solo el poder y el dinero importan. Usa sus heridas como arma, avanza con estrategia, arrebata acciones y proyectos, y aplasta a quienes lo oprimieron hasta convertirse en el heredero legítimo.

title: Dalia and the Red Book

title: Al-Khimyah
description: Al-Khimyah explores the work of the Aga Khan Trust for Culture (AKTC) in the historic city of Cairo, Egypt. The film shines a spotlight on the 30-hectare Al-Azhar Park - converted from a mound of rubble - and the stories of local residents of the adjacent al-Darb al-Ahmar neighbourhood. The park has also proven to be a powerful catalyst for urban renewal, evolving beyond the green space itself to include the restoration of monuments and public spaces, and socioeconomic initiatives including housing rehabilitation, microfinance, crafts apprenticeships, and healthcare. Since opening in 2005 after 20 years of careful excavation and design, Al-Azhar Park has provided much-needed leisure and recreational space to the inhabitants of the city, and is today often referred to as "Cairo's green lung."

title: Tonight at Noon
description: Lee (Chiwetel Ejiofor) and Mae (Lauren Ambrose) are a couple trying to work out their differences. As Mae struggles with memories of a former flame, Lee, who is a writer, works through his frustration by forming his problems into a story in his mind. title: Orson at the Orient
description: Orson at the Orient is the story of a meeting no one admits happened: A bombed city under martial law and powers on the verge of a new war give home to deceit and uncertainty in 1948 Vienna. The city, divided among the allied powers, is also hosting the filming of The Third Man. It's star, American actor Orson Welles is spending his after-hours in the well-known Hotel Orient, soon to be disturbed by Soviet troops led by a young Officer. On his mind only one mission. How can he use the strengths and weaknesses of the great Orson to change the course of history, while in the U.S. big Hollywood names are targeted in the Red Scare initiating the McCarthy era.

title: Talking Back at Thunder

title: Au pays des colons
description: In the 1930s, in the throes of the Great Depression, the government of Quebec relocated more than 80,000 citizens to found a new settlement in the virgin forests of Quebec's Abitibi region. After enduring backbreaking work to clear the land, however, many left, seeking a better life in the city or as labourers for the large corporations that had come to exploit the North's valuable resources. The Lalancette family, however, have persisted in forging their future on the land from one generation to the next, earning their keep from farming, and defying the constraints of globalization and the mining and forestry companies that control the area. Revisiting the heritage of Quebec filmmakers who documented Abitibi, following in the footsteps of Pierre Perrault, among others, this documentary traces a defining chapter of Quebec history and raises fundamental questions about regional development.

title: Poly au Portugal
description: Pascal is spending a holiday in Portugal with two other French children called Richard and Mariane. They are staying at a working farm owned by José and Theresa Costa near to a fishing village on the coast. Pascal's horse, Poly arrives on a boat from France to join them, but promptly disappears into the local countryside. Poly soon reappears and leads the children to a wanted man on the run who claims to be searching for his missing son. With the aid of Poly, a fisherman called Faustino and the village children, Pascal, Richard and Mariane set out to solve the mystery. They are constantly hindered by inflexible village policeman Bernardo, who prefers to follow regulations to the letter at all times.

title: Le dernier au revoir

Her father, Alfred, decides to organize the funerals so that Olivia can say her goodbyes. Jacynthe, Olivia's mother, thinks it may be easier to simply replace Fishy with another animal blessed with a higher life expectancy. But Alfred want Olivia to remember a very important lesson: one must always say goodbye to a loved one.

title: A Barefoot Dream
description: After a series of pipe dream ventures go belly up, retired pro soccer player Kim Won-kang happens to visit East Timor, where he finds children playing the game barefoot on rocky pitches. Sensing a new business opportunity on finding the country doesn't have a single sporting goods store, he embarks on a scheme to get rich quick by purveying athletic shoes to the unshod youngsters. Sadly, no one there can afford to pay $60 for a pair of shoes, even on a generous installment plan, and before he knows it, he is reduced to coaching a team of ragged 10-year-olds and prospects are looking grim.

title: Being Fired? Now I'm Out of Their League!
description: Forced into an engagement, Julian follows his grandpa's order, works at Harper Enterprise, secretly making Serena the new Wall Street business queen. But Serena and her assistant Damian drive him out, and the company collapses without him.

title: Deet N Bax Save Th' World
description: Bloody Stoner Odyssey full of Sex, Guns'n Weed.

title: Song-o
description: A group of city dwellers make a trip of three days and two nights into the isolated countryside to visit a friend in the hills. Their true nature begins to reveal itself: love hidden but never forgotten, primitive desires suppressed in the city, nasty pride that triumphs only over the weak and a strong will for survival that sacrifices even love and friendship.

title: O Novo CEO é o Meu Ginecologista (Dublado)
description: Clara vive presa em um casamento sem intimidade e desenvolve hipersexualidade. Em busca de ajuda, ela é humilhada pelo Dr. Killian durante um exame, pouco antes de descobrir a traição do marido. A reviravolta acontece quando o novo CEO da empresa se revela ser o próprio Killian. Ele passa a se aproveitar da condição dela, forçando-a à submissão e levando o relacionamento dos dois ao limite.

title: Ballada o Januszku
description: A single mother, blinded by the love for her trouble-making son Januszek, makes more and more sacrifices for him.

title: Bhalobasa O Andhakar
description: Bhalobasa-O-Andhakar is a 1992 Indian Bengali film, directed by Dipranjan Bose and produced by Bhalobasa-O-Andhakar Roy. The film stars Sanchita Bose, Kushal Chakraborty and Satya Banerjee in lead roles. Music of the film was composed by Goutam Chatterjee.

title: O Governante Supremo
description: O protagonista, dotado de superpoderes, fica ainda mais forte após um período de cultivo. Ele derrota e elimina todos os vilões que antes o intimidavam. Para salvar sua mãe, ele enfrenta inúmeros perigos. No final, ao reunir a força de seu povo, ele supera a rebelião e se torna o líder supremo.

title: Shangoul o Mangoul
description: On a field trip a young schoolteacher named Mary [Afsaneh Bayegan] tells the story Shangoul and Mangoul to the children: The lion, as king of the jungle, sets up a contest between the wolf and the fox where he will hire the one who brings him delicious food the soonest. The wolf and the fox kidnap the baby goats (Shangoul, Mangoul and Grape). The wolf decides to eat Shangoul and Mangoul himself but the fox takes Grape to the lion. The mother goat goes looking for her children and she and other the animals of the forest restrain the wolf and the fox; the baby goats are returned to their mother safe and sound.

title: Entre Dois Alfas: O Passado vs. O Presente
description: Com dezoito anos, fui obrigada a escolher um dos filhos do Alfa como meu companheiro. Na vida passada, escolhi Cain — um grande erro. Ele me destruiu por completo. Desta vez, escolhi Casey, o de sangue frio, o mais brutal de todos. O que eu não esperava era que Cain também tivesse voltado.

title: Segunda Chance: O Caminho para o Bilhão(Dublado)
description: Na vida passada, Henrique usou os quatro milhões ganhos na loteria para fingir ser herdeiro e entrar na elite. Achou que conhecer poderosos mudaria seu destino, mas, dez anos depois, foi desmascarado e humilhado em público. Ao despertar, descobre que renasceu e voltou ao verão do último ano escolar. Com os quatro milhões, lucra com oportunidades na madeira, nos futuros de borracha e no petróleo. Desta vez, não vai fingir ser rico: vai construir a própria fortuna do zero!

title: Enchi o Banco do Além até o Limite
description:
Com a chegada do Submundo, Daniel Soares, que morreu nesse mundo em sua vida passada, renasce antes do evento com uma interface de jogo. Usando dinheiro ritual, ele abastece completamente sua conta no Submundo, adquirindo riqueza ilimitada.

Quando o Submundo finalmente desce sobre o mundo, Daniel usa sua fortuna infinita para forjar três artefatos divinos, evolui sua classe de ferreiro de nível D para Ferreiro Divino e, após três evoluções, ascende ao posto de Deus Criador. No fim, ele derrota o chefe final do mundo do Submundo.

title: Demon Lord, Retry!
description: On the night of his favorite game's shutdown, Akira Oono awakens in the body of his online character: Demon Lord Hakuto Kunai.

title: PELANGI IN WAEREBO | Documentary Film
description: Halo sahabat edukasi, Tahukah kamu tentang masyarakat Waerebo? Masyarakat Waerebo berada di Flores pada ketinggian 1.200 meter di atas permukaan laut ini layaknya sebuah surga yang berada di atas awan. Pemandangan alam berupa gunung-gunung berpadu dengan 7 rumah adat berbentuk kerucut akan memberi kesan tersendiri bagi setiap pengunjung yang pernah datang ke Desa Wae Rebo. Desa Wae Rebo berada di barat daya kota Ruteng, Kabupaten Manggarai, Nusa Tenggara Timur. Untuk bisa sampai ke lokasi memang tidak mudah karena letaknya yang di atas gunung. Rumah adat Wae Rebo sangat menarik untuk dilihat dan bagaimana dibangun dengan kontruksi tanpa mengunakan paku melainkan di ikat. Rumah adat Wae Rebo bernama Mbaru Niang memiliki sembilan tiang utama dan konon rumah niang ini berkontruksi anti gempa. Dengan senandung lagu yang epic hingga mempertahankan kehidupan tradisional dan menjaga keseimbangan alam serta mempertahankan tradisi dan budaya Wae Rebo patut. Yang menarik dari desa Wae Rebo adalah Anak-anak Wae Rebo tetap sekolah walaupun jarak antara sekolah dan rumah mereka sangat jauh demi mengejar ilmu pengetahuan dan cita-cita. title: Sewing pattern making bangla tutorial. Pant pattern draft/making
description:
Easy way of garments pattern making/drafting/Draping
Pattern grading, Pattern balancing. fabric consumption. All kinds of pattern such as shirt, pant, jacket, overall, shortall, t-shirt, skirt, blazer etc make easily. Garment pattern making is the process of creating flat, two-dimensional shapes that, when cut from fabric and sewn together, will form a three-dimensional garment that fits the body.CAD (Computer-Aided Design) in the context of garment patterns refers to the use of specialized software to create, modify, analyze, and manage these patterns digitally. Here's a breakdown of garment patterns and CAD in this industry: Definition: A pattern is a template, usually made of paper or cardboard, representing individual pieces of a garment. Each piece is cut from fabric and then joined with others to construct the final product.         Accuracy: Ensures consistent sizing and fit across multiple garments.
        Replication: Allows for easy reproduction of a design in various sizes.
        Efficiency: Optimizes fabric usage during cutting.
        Communication: Provides a clear blueprint for the cutting and sewing stages of 
    Methods of Pattern Making:
        Draping: Manipulating fabric directly on a dress form to create the desired shape. The fabric is then marked and transferred to paper to create the pattern.
        Flat Pattern: Creating patterns on a flat surface (paper or digitally) using measurements and drafting techniques. This often involves adapting basic pattern blocks (slopers) to create new styles.
        Computerized Pattern Making (CAD): Creating and manipulating patterns digitally using specialized software. This method is increasingly popular due to its precision, speed, and ability to integrate with other stages of garment production.
CAD for Garment Patterns:
CAD systems have revolutionized pattern making in the garment industry, offering numerous advantages over traditional manual methods. Sewing pattern making bangla tutorial.

title: Tapasya vs Temptation [Bengali]
description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

title: Secret Billionaire [Bengali]
description: College student Damon Hemsworth has been brought up by his poor mother. Mocked by his peers and dumped by his girlfriend because of his poverty, Damon doesn't have much to look forward to. Until, one day, a phone call changes his life. Damon finds out that his father runs the Serafino family business which is by far the richest in the world. Damon receives ten million dollars from his father and the trajectory of his life changes. Join us on an exhilarating audio journey as we unravel Damon's extraordinary tale. Embark on a rollercoaster ride of intrigue, power games, self-discovery as Damon navigates the complexities of his newfound wealth, family dynamics, and the expectations that come with his prestigious lineage. From humble beginnings to the lap of luxury, Damon's story is a gripping narrative of self-discovery and adaptation. As he grapples with his dual identity and adjusts to the opulent lifestyle of his birthright, Damon must confront the challenges of his newfound fortune. Will being a secret billionaire be a boon or a curse? To find out, listen to 'Secret Billionaire', exclusively on KUKU FM.

title: After Divorce, My Wife Became A Trillionaire [Bengali]
description: He thought she'd be nothing without him—until she returned richer, stronger, and absolutely untouchable. This audio show unpacks a whirlwind journey of heartbreak, revenge, and billion-dollar power moves. Tune in to witness how a woman turns betrayal into unstoppable success.

title: My CEO made me Pregnant [Bengali]
description: My CEO made me Pregnant is a high-stakes romantic drama where powerful secrets, betrayal, and hidden identities collide as Leena, a brilliant tech genius, fights to reclaim her place and protect her unborn child. Amidst corporate wars and emotional chaos, she must expose lies, survive conspiracies, and stand against the man she once loved.

title: A Reflection
description: Camilla's father is about to die. She's on her way to her family home to meet her mother. But it hasn't been home, and they haven't been a family, for years. And she's just seen a dragon out of the train window.

title: A Cartomante
description: Rita is about to marry a wealthy physician, Dr. Augusto Vilela. One night, Vilela's best friend, Camilo, is brought to the hospital, dying from an overdose. Vilela saves his life and introduces him to his fiancée. Rita and Camilo fall in love and, confused about what to do, the girl goes to a fortuneteller to seek for advice.

title: A Opção
description: The saga of rural women who decide to leave the countryside and get into prostitution. Their miserable lives are marked by fortuitous meetings with truck drivers, pimps, thieves and lunatics.

title: A Dal
description: The Song series was the selection competition of the Eurovision Song Contest in Hungary, a talent search program that since 2020, has been on display independently of the international song festival.

title: A Mother In A Maid's Uniform
description: A Mother In A Maid's Uniform

title: A Buddha
description: Un Buda follows two brothers orphaned as children when their parents were taken by the military during the "Dirty Wars" of the 1970s in Argentina. Tomas (Agustin Markert) is now a drifting and withdrawn young man who experiments with ascetic practices and has an instinctive compassion for others. His older brother Rafael, played by Rafecas, is a university philosophy professor, detached and alone. Their struggles with each other and the world around them in Buenos Aires take a dramatic turn when they find themselves at a rural Zen center.

title: A Cozinha
description: Miguel is an artist dealing with depression. As an attempt to try to overcome this moment, he invites Rodrigo, a friend he hasn't seen for over 15 years, to his house. On the day of the meeting, Leticia, Miguel's ex-girlfriend, shows up before his guest. The unpleasant mood intensifies when Rodrigo arrives not alone, but with his fiancé, Carla. Banalities briefly mask the awkwardness of the unexpected encounter, but as alcohol kicks in, libido rises and shyness drops. When Leticia jokes about Miguel's sexuality, he brings back an old memory that turns a simple dinner into a spiral of sorrow, desire, violence and liberation that redefines the night and the life of the quartet.

title: A Promessa
description: A couple of traditional fishermen are linked by a secret vote of chastity. One day, they take in a wounded gypsy man, out of their Christian piety. As time goes by, a relationship, and love emerges between the healthy young woman and the gypsy. The reaction of the local society, and the explosion of repressed sentiments will come to a swirling vortex of violence - abduction, shootings, and forced sex.

title: Like a Prayer: A Documentary Film
description: In Like a Prayer, we follow real life stories about fan's who've attended over 150 concerts of one artist. Another that moves from one country to another, just to be closer to their idol. One who spends half the year away from their family to attend their favorite singers shows, and one that takes out loans to be able to afford a concert ticket - And its all for their love of Madonna. But where is the line between reality and illusion? "Like a Prayer" is the first documentary film of its kind exploring the other side of fandom that will surprise you. It could even change your life.

title: A Deadwood Story: A Cat's Tail
A Mother's Love, A Daughter's Resolve
description: Jing Fang brings good news, having been accepted into university, while Jing Jie also lies about being accepted but is secretly planning to scam money for tuition. Meanwhile, the gambling-addicted and cheating Jing Jianguo, in order to elope with his mistress, steals all the family's money and disappears without a trace. Faced with the high tuition fees, the family's already dire situation only worsens. Jing Fang, unwilling to burden her mother, offers to drop out and work. However, Luo Yuxia firmly refuses and insists that both children must go to school. How will Luo Yuxia cope with these mounting challenges?

title: I Married a Princess as a Blacksmith
description: I Married a Princess as a Blacksmith🧡🍏 🔥 (2026) - FULL ENGSUB

title: A Killer Party: A Murder Mystery Musical
description: When the artistic director of a failing theater in Duluth invited his troupe of actors and collaborators to the first read of an "immersive murder mystery dinner party," no one knew that the host would be the victim. Or did they? Enter eager, determined, and untested Detective Justine Case. After sequestering the guests into separate rooms, she gets down to finding out whodunnit - uncovering showmances, life-long grudges, backstage drama, and a whole lot of song and dance. Case vows to find the truth and secure her future as a great detective.

title: Conception
description: A group of bored well-off young adults come up with anarchic concept of Conceptionism, that promotes absolute looseness when it comes to sex and drugs, but total rejection of money and ego. However, their movement won't last long.

description: Alice is a woman whose firefighter fiance disappeared after a 911 call. She finds him again three years later, now a billionaire. The problem? He has amnesia and is now engaged to another woman. Will she be able to win him back again?

title: Bass Ackwards
description: A younger woman, Jeralyn, falls for her best friend's older cousin, Julian. His atheism and kinky sex past make her question their relationship. Her best friend, Zaira, is faced with the dilemma of coming out to her parents or losing her relationship with her girlfriend.

title: We Got Lucky
description: After his girlfriend justifiably storms off and ditches him at her friend Heather's apartment, carefree Aaron asks Heather's much more responsible boyfriend Brad, whom he just met, if he can crash at their place that night. Brad and Heather eventually break up, but Aaron winds up never leaving and, over the years, strikes up a friendship with Brad that becomes a brotherhood.

title: She Takes Revenge after Rebirth
description: Many years ago, a charming young actor in the show business, ignoring conventional views, pursued a voluptuous film queen with vigor, which became a celebrated tale for a time. Later on, the young actor himself was crowned an emperor of cinema. In the same year, his adored wife and their four-year-old daughter were victims of a burglary, leading to widespread sorrow. But is this the truth? No, the truth is, he personally took the lives of his own wife and child.

title: Robby
description: Shipwrecked on a tropical island, a young boy befriends an abandoned native youth, forcing him to reevaluate societal prejudice about race, religion and nudity.

title: Housing the American Dream
description: Unique home building series that is centered on a core project.

title: Quinton
description: Quinton, a professional bachelor asks a skulduggery tarot reader of his future and faces true consequences of deception and deceit instead of trusting ones own instinct to live, to love, and to survive.

title: Son's Whispers Unveil Betrayal (English-dubbed)
description: Realizing the danger he is in, Eliot believes adopting Nolan is the only way to stop the tragedy. He chooses Nolan instead of Mia, seeing the boy as his only ally. With Nolan's constant inner reminders, Eliot carefully collects evidence of Lila's conspiracy. He also seeks help from his sisters, who stand by him against Lila's manipulation.

title: Horror Game: She’s a Monster, I See a Hottie

title: Reel Combat
description: Reel Combat is the ultimate head to head competition for movie lovers. Two contestants, each with a movie of their choice face off to convince The Scene Snob to watch their choice.

title: The Wolf [Hindi]
description: The script tells the story of Kuizhou City Princess Zhaixing and a young wolf cub who grew up in a wolf pack, and they met after missing eight years. The two fought for love and fate.

title: Kidnapped by the Mafia
description: Sold by her boyfriend to the mafia king Vincenzo as his contract bride, Violet plans her escape. Yet she discovers Vincenzo's heart of gold... that belongs to her.  When danger strikes, Vincenzo saves Violet and suffers grave injuries, leading her to marry him out of duty and gratitude. But during their wedding ceremony, an assassination plot unfolds…

title: The Ex-Wife Is the Real Billionaire
description: Selena hid her billionaire status for six years to protect her husband's pride. When she finds him engaged to a fake heiress who hurt their daughter Lily, she cuts his funding and walks away. Poisoned and hunted, she still outplays every betrayer to keep her child safe.

description: Under her stepmother's pressure, Alicia substitutes her sister to marry a stranger. Disheartened, she finds solace in Lucius's company for a night. Later, at the wedding, she discovers Lucius is the groom, sparking an unexpected love story.

title: Magic Academy: Winning Over Four Elite Heirs
description: Transmigrated into a magical world as a powerless younger sister, Cestia is abused by her own family and fated to die on the streets. After bonding with a System, she launches a forceful conquest: Severin, the abstinent professor; Cecil, the vengeful manservant; Branlit, her obsessive adoptive brother; and Ragnar, the dangerous dark wizard—all fall under her sway! But with four exceptional men vying for her love, whom will she choose?

title: Dream Garden [Hindi]
description: A self-media blogger and psychologist clash on a dating show, then work together when she becomes his assistant. Through helping others with psychological cases, they grow closer and improve each other, despite looming conflicts.

The only way in however, is becoming the mafia boss—David Lewis’ BDSM“plaything”. By submitting to every humiliating command from David, Wendy thinks she is getting closer to the truth. Until she realizes that he already knows why she’s here…

title: I, Cesar
description: Cesar is a young schoolboy living in Paris with his family. Their life is ordinary, but Cesar wants more excitement (which he creates, in one instance, by claiming to his teachers that his father has been arrested). During the school holidays, Cesar and his friend Sarah decide to help their mutual friend, Morgan, find his father who supposedly lives in London. Each one tells their parents that they're staying with the other two, and together they sneak out to begin their search.

title: I televisionari
description: 'I televisionari' [literally 'the Televisionairies'] delves back into the extraordinary history of the birth of 'free TV' in Italy, i.e. the first ever private TV stations. They challenged the monopolistic grip that the state has had on broadcasting since 1954. We have put together the final pieces of a complex but exciting jigsaw puzzle. This was a magnificent period that is now in jeopardy. Year after year we see it inexorably wiped from our memories as its leading protagonists disappear. We will hear these protagonists tell the fascinating stories that accompanied this incredible journey. This documentary will try to give viewers a vivid picture of this colourful reality to give them back a taste of that bygone era. To do that, we will try to recover films, photographs and equipment used at that time and then abandoned on some dusty shelf or jealously kept by some keen aficionado. We will rediscover those unlikely places where these first TV programmes were made, such as living rooms, wine cellars and garages. These were the places where sheer enthusiasm, which has long since disappeared, made up for the lack of money.

description: Nothing endures like the human spirit.

description: After losing their dance partners, Alaina, the blue-collar belle of the ball, must partner with her nemesis, Xavier, the bad boy of the ballroom, for a shot at the title: National Teen Dance Champion. Not killing each other would be a win.

title: Adam i Kheva
description: Bekir, in anger divorces his wife Kheva, which he regrets. Because of Sharia, she can return if she marries another and is expelled by him. Bekir arranges with Adam, to briefly marry and expel her. Neither Kheva, nor Adam want to separate.

title: Brødre i krig
description:
How much is a brother's life worth? Joining the Nazi party at the height of the Second World War? Or fighting for the German Army?

Bernhard Brekke had to go through with both of these drastic measures when his brother Erling was caught as a spy for the English in 1941 and sentenced to execution. If Bernhard did as the Germans said, his brother would be saved. And Erling was pardoned, but sent to Concentration Camps in Germany, where he remained for almost four years. Bernhard on the other hand, was sent to the heart of a Germany at war. While his brother was living under the worst conditions in German captivity, Bernhard had to fight the Russians on the Eastern Front.

They struggled for survival on different sides during the war, but they both returned in May 1945, one a War hero, the other sentenced and jailed as a Traitor against his own country. Today they have both become two old men, with each their own remarkable story of how to overcome a difficult past. Brothers at War is about the choices of two brothers during the Second World War, and the consequences of these choices in the years to follow from then to now.

It's a film about strong family ties, but also a story of distrust, intrigue and condemnation in the wake of the War. And a meeting between two brothers after almost 70 years, where they conclude that the so called Traitor is the real Hero.

title: Seytan-i Ins
description: Semih lives in Istanbul with his grandmother. His father and mother died of a sin thirty years before this. However, Semih knows that her parents had died in a traffic accident. Semih begins to have strange dreams in his last years. He tries to find all his secrets by going to his native village. Salih, whom Semih met in the village, has all the secrets and answers.

title: Gaia Symphony I
description: Gaia is the name of the Goddess of the Earth in Greek mythology. British scientist Dr. James Lovelock proposed a theory that the Earth itself is a giant living organism. He calls this theory Gaia.

title: I Survived Death, Now I Hunt the Apocalypse
description: A university student, Elio Conway, transmigrates to a world where people can summon Eidolons. The one who summoned him promptly breaks their pact, leaving him to die without a care. On the brink of death, Elio awakens the Predation Evolution System, which allows him to evolve into increasingly powerful forms. When an apocalyptic wave of monsters arrives, Elio stands with humanity to defend it.

title: Paja i Jare
description: The adventures of a truck driver and his fellow associate, who both leave their company refusing to meet the newly introduced criteria of having elementary school degree. Being in their 40s and totally talentless for education, they decide to leave the company and go private. However, the world outside their company has been completely changed over the years, and after the series of bad lucks, they will summarize their position and go back to school.

title: Decak i violina
description: The war is over. Children without mothers and fathers, children of fighters who fell for freedom...This is the story about such boys who placed in the homes for children of fallen soldiers. One of these homes was especially for boys with gift for music. One of them was a boy named Goran. he and his best friend exchanged violins. The difference in violins was only in color, but this one reminded him strangely of the past he past. All his boyish feelings and is tender memories of his mother killed in war, Goran put into his music, producing wonderful sounds on the dark violin. title: Music Bank K-Chart
description: Music Bank K-Chart is KBS's long-run music chart show that airs live every Friday. The Top 50 songs of the week are featured on K-Chart. Every week, various K-pop artists come on the show to showcase their music and dance moves. It's a concert of all the popular artists that you can watch in the comfort of your home. From newly debuted rookies, artists making a comeback from their hiatus, indie bands, globally recognized idol groups, and much more, they will be able to satisfy your needs for K-pop. With eye-catching performances and melody that will echo in your heart, this music festival can provide viewing pleasure for those who are not even familiar with K-pop. Tune in every week and pay attention to see which artist and song wins the most popular song of the week.

description: Overweight, kind-hearted Sa Geum-ran (Ha Jae-sook) married into a well-to-do family.

title: The Yakshagana Puppets
description: The Yakshagana Puppets, is a 2016 Indian documentary film directed by Kiranraj K. This is the first ever documentary film on Yakshagana Puppets. The film is regarding the long time experiments and achievements of Sri Gopalakrishna Yakshagana Bombeyata Sangha, Kasaragod (Puppet show troupe) which has been working for the rejuvenation of Tenkuthittu Yakshagana Bombeyata (Southern style yakshagana puppet show) through demonstrations and shows is being produced. The film covers the full gamut of puppetry from its making up to its stage show. Even the amazement experienced by the spectators including the inquisitive students on witnessing the wonderful puppet shows has not escaped the camera eye. The fascinating natural scenes on the banks of river Chandragiri can also be enjoyed through this film. The opinion of the young and elderly lovers of this artform also has been recorded in this documentary. The film is shaped on the basis of Hindu mythological stories and therefore the scenes of temples and images of the deities worshipped in the temples have also been pictured in this film.

title: O Grande Momento
description: On the day of his wedding, young man from a family of immigrants faces some problems to get the money needed for the last arrangements. The family do what they can in order to honour the great event, selling personal belongings and buying enough supplies for a decent party.

title: The Stigma
description: After riding for hours in the woods, Bruno sees a farm and decides to carry it. There he is welcomed by Laura, a beautiful girl in a blue apron, who introduces him to the owner of the house. What Bruno didn't expect was that Fausto, his college friend, would be the owner of the property. During dinner, Bruno realized that his wife, a rich and viscerally evil woman, was keeping Fausto and his daughters under control. After 20 years, Bruno returns to the place and finds Fausto quite changed. His wife and Laura had mysteriously died. Fausto invites him to dinner and hear what had happened: the story of a brand, a stigma embedded in his son's chest, would be the key to unveiling this mystery.

title: O Agios Nektarios
description: A dancer, Vera, is married to a nuclear scientist, Tasos. She suffers from multiple sclerosis and is in very bad condition. In a little church on Aegina, according to rumors, supernatural things happen. True miracles. The President of the community is Tasos' father, and so Tasos himself has the chance to experience from up close many remarkable incidents. Bedridden Vera reads the biography of Saint Nektarios, patron saint of the island, whose life we follow in parallel. This strengthens the religious faith of both the heroine and her husband. A new diagnosis, however, changes the facts, and Vera, after a surgical operation, is completely cured.

title: O Clã das Jiboias: O Jiu-Jitsu da Amazônia para o Mundo
description: It's a historical and anthropological look at the sport with the biggest cultural impact in Amazonas, Brazil, starting with the Japanese immigration of a group of fighters, up to its revival in the 1970s with Reyson Gracie coming to Manaus.

title: Internet: O Filme
description: The most famous Brazilian youtubers gather in a hotel for a convention.

title: Anima o ute!
description: Kaho is a member of BAN, a classical ballet company. She wants to take an audition in order to be selected to study abroad, but hasn't found the moves she likes. She discovers that Ito, who works at the dance hall, used to drum, and decides to combine contemporary dance and drums for the final audition.

title: Koritsia o Markoulis
description: The everyday life during his visits at his hotel by quirky Markos who manages it.

title: O Escorpião Escarlate
description: O Anjo (The Angel) is a millionaire playboy who fights the forces of crime, especially his deadly enemy, the arch-villain Escorpião Escarlate (Scarlet Scorpion), who recently has kidnapped the fashion designer Glória Campos, who is in love with our hero.

title: Lygos, o leventis
description: We are in the 1900's and a young aristocrat, Eftihia Notara, visits her family's estate with her father. There she meets and falls in love with their beautiful biscuit, Tasos Ligos, whose sister Mario loves the rich Kitsos. When the relationship between the two young people becomes more widely known, Lygos asks Kitsos to marry his sister, otherwise he will kill her. Kitsos dies suddenly, while Ligos is now blamed for his death, now forced to go out into the mountains.

title: Alexandros o Macedon
description: A letter received by Queen Olympias from her son Alexander, becomes an occasion for unfolding meetings, memories and visions of the great mercenary shortly before he leaves his last breath.

title: Blaze o' Glory
description: On trial for the murder of Carl Hummel, Eddie Williams tells his story, which begins just before the World War: Eddie, a Broadway star, marries Helen and almost immediately goes to the front. Gassed while saving the life of a German soldier (Hummel), Eddie cannot find work when he returns. Helen finds a job, and Eddie grows more despondent. One day he finds Helen in Hummel's arms, and in his rage Eddie shoots the man. The trial proceeds with the revelation by Defense Attorney Burke, Eddie's wartime commander, of Helen's secret: she pretended to be single so as to get work; Hummel, who was searching for Eddie, really loved Helen and was ignorant of her relationship with Eddie. The jury finds Eddie not guilty.

title: Hooch & Daddy-O
description: A documentary crew explores the pop culture impact of the '80s cop show "Hooch & Daddy-O" and what happens when the cast reunites to film a made-for-TV movie.

title: Apaixonados: O Filme
description: Three couples meet in the middle of Carnival, trying to get together in the midst of various conflicts that have the biggest party in Brazil as a scenario - and often as a cause.

title: Rose o' Paradise
description: After his wife's death, Thomas Singleton suffers a temporary breakdown and is committed to an asylum by his scheming half brother, Jordon Morse. Although Jordon has been appointed the guardian of Thomas' little daughter Virginia, he shuns the responsibility, placing the girl in the care of an old mammy and planning to retrieve her only on her eighteenth birthday, when she comes into possession of her mother's fortune. Sixteen years pass. Thomas, deeply worried about his daughter's well-being, escapes the asylum, and after sending Virginia to live with a poor but kindly cobbler named Lafe Grandoken, he dies. Virginia's chance meeting with millionaire Theodore King leads to romance, and her happiness is complete until Morse, anxious to secure her money, hires Maudlin Bates to kill Theodore. When Bates, plotting to double-cross Morse, threatens Lafe, Morse enters and shoots the gunman, but Lafe is accused. Morse imprisons Virginia, but she escapes in time to free Lafe and bring the villain to justice.

title: The Heat After the AC Died
description: Ever since their parents married, Becca has hated her stepbrother, Samir. For two years, she's blamed him for stealing her family, her home, and the life she lost. As Samir struggles to fix the broken air conditioner, lingering resentment gives way to lingering touches. The line between hate and desire begins to disappear, and Becca must face the one truth. She's spent years denying that the man she's forbidden to want may be the only one she can't resist.

title: I Am a Ghost
description: Emily, a troubled spirit, haunts her own house every day, wondering why she can't leave. With the help of Sylvia, a clairvoyant hired to rid the house of spirits, Emily is forced into a 'patient/therapist' relationship, uncovering disturbing mysteries about her past that may help her move on to 'the next place'.

headers.User-Agent: com.community.oneroom/50020119 (Linux; U; Android 10; en_US; M2007J20CG; Build/QP1A.191005.007.A3; Cronet/135.0.7012.3)

title: I Am My Own Woman
description: The life story of Charlotte von Mahlsdorf, born Lothar Berflede. Miss Charlotte survived the Nazi reign and the repression of the Communists as a transvestite and helped start the German gay liberation movement. Documentary with some dramatized scenes. Two actors play the young and middle aged Charlotte and she plays herself in the later years.

title: I Am the Revolution
description: The inspiring story of three women risking their lives to incite political, activist, and armed uprisings in Afghanistan, Syria, and Iraq.

title: BLK: An Origin Story
description: BLK: An Origin Story is a four part doc series that looks beyond the Underground Railroad to explore the Untold Stories of Black Canadians from the 1600s to the present. These four hours aim to show that Black History is Canadian History.

title: The Unexpected Marriage
description: Based on a novel by A Ci, the story follows Princess Changsheng who's said to "hate marriage." Known for her wit, cleverness, and beauty, she decides to pursue her own love.

title: Detection of Di Renjie
description: In Empress Wu's reign, there are several bizarre deaths in the capital city of Chang'an. The rumors of the Martyrs Shrine's "Flying Goddess Mural" murder case are getting worse. Di Renjie is ordered to investigate the case. He cracks the mystery of the mural based on the characteristics of the Flower Sermon, which leads to the murderer, Li Luoyu. Soon after, Li Luoyu commits suicide. After multiple investigations, Di finally finds out the true murderer.

headers.User-Agent: com.community.oneroom/50020119 (Linux; U; Android 10; en_US; M2007J20CG; Build/QP1A.191005.007.A3; Cronet/135.0.7012.3)

title: The Big Case on the Mekong River
description: The Mekong River, one of the major waterways of Southeast Asia, has suddenly turned ominously bloody. Two Chinese cargo ships, the Hua Ping, and the Yu Xing 8, are hijacked by eight unknown gunmen on a misty October morning. Shots ring out, bodies thrown overboard, and the Thai police afterwards find 900,000 amphetamine pills on-board; an intense international investigation is called between China, Thailand, Laos, and Burma to help recover the bodies of the victimized crews, and to bring vengeance and justice to those who committed the atrocious deed. However, things gradually turn ugly as mistrust envelops the case, where death could reveal itself one turn away.

title: Piloto de Oito Anos: Rumo ao Céu (Dublado)
description: O piloto de elite Raul, agora com 8 anos, revive o voo em que viajava com seu pai. Ele sabe que todos morrerão num acidente. Com asas em chamas e vento gelado invadindo a cabine, ele precisa usar sua experiência e corpinho de 8 anos para evitar a tragédia e salvar seu pai e os passageiros. Enfrentando desconfiança, comandante desmaiado, comunicação perdida e apenas 1% de chance de sucesso, Raul encara seu maior desafio.

title: Rock in Rio: Cassia Eller Ao Vivo
Do Peão Descartado ao Rei da Jogada
description: Carlos cresceu carregando o estigma de filho ilegítimo, criado pela mãe. Até os dezoito anos, o pai dele, um chefão respeitado no meio, apareceu do nada. O defendeu diante da professora e o levou de volta para os Cunha. O que o esperava era um acordo frio, disfarçado de afeto familiar. Precisando pagar o tratamento da mãe, ele aceitou. A partir daí, trilhou um caminho de sangue e fogo. Pela mãe, por todos que amava, ele deu tudo de si, até fazer o meio inteiro tremer!

title: O Gênio Engenheiro que Chegou ao Trono
description: Um jovem da área de ciências exatas reencarna como filho ilegítimo de uma família imperial. Em sua cerimônia de maioridade, é humilhado em público pelo irmão legítimo, escolhe um feudo pobre e se casa com três mulheres rejeitadas por todos. Usando seu conhecimento moderno, ele desenvolve pólvora, mineração e perfumes, conquista o povo e consegue até fazer chover. De filho ilegítimo desprezado, se transforma em um senhor feudal poderoso e respeitado.

title: Bhikhari Boss
description:
A billionaire hiding as a beggar to escape an arranged marriage. An orphan girl abandoned at the altar on her wedding day. Two strangers with nothing — and everything to lose.
When fate throws them together at the worst moment of both their lives, the most unlikely deal is struck.
This is a story of two broken people who accidentally become each other's biggest plot twist.

title: Golden Boy Ki Love Story
description: Yohan, a hidden billionaire, marries Suhana, who is forced to wed to save her inheritance. As love grows, he reveals his true identity and protects her from betrayal and danger. In the end, they overcome all odds and find happiness together.

title: Fake Doctor
description:
A ward boy with a cancelled medical license. A fiancée who's ashamed of him. A hospital hiding more secrets than its patients.
Vedant is kind, dedicated, and quietly brilliant — but invisible to the world he serves. When betrayal forces him to confront everything he's ignored, a man written off as "just a ward boy" must prove that real medicine was never about the coat.
This is a story of a man rediscovering his worth, one diagnosis at a time.

title: King's Killer Comeback

Shaadi ka setup ego clashes aur hidden truths ka battlefield ban jaata hai, jahan har episode ke saath tension aur stakes badhte hain. yeh story greed, ambition aur ultimate power reveal ko explore karti hai

title: Dream
description: Years ago, journalist Shen Yueshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now, she returns to Lacheng, picking up her camera again to explore those corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian were once the protagonists of her lens, yet their fates have been shaped by the passage of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time, and Shen Yueshui travels between the past and the present, uncovering these long-forgotten tales.

title: Crash Course Geology
description:
In 25 episodes, we’re going to learn about geology—the study of Earth’s physical structure and processes. Our host, Sage, will teach you about the geological forces and cycles that shape our planet’s past, present, and future. 

This content is based on an introductory university-level curriculum. By the end of this course, you should be able to: 

Trace Earth’s development from its earliest periods to its current structure
Understand the forces of plate tectonics and how they shape Earth’s landscape
Describe the formation of geologic elements like minerals, rocks, and gems 
Identify geologic forces and cycles that impact the earth, while dispelling myths about extreme geological hazards
Learn what geology reveals about Earth’s distant past and what it can teach us about our current changing climate
Explore the geology of other planets within the context of Earth’s unique and common qualities and phenomena
Become familiar with different specialities within geology and what different types of geologists do

Key texts cited include:
Marshak, Stephen. 2021. Earth: Portrait of a Planet, Seventh Edition.
Babcock, Loren E. 2009. Gemstones and Precious Metals.

title: Speak English Professionally: In Person, Online & On the Phone
description:
Do you want to speak better English? This course will help you reach that goal. Speak English Professionally: In person, Online and On the Phone will boost your English speaking skills. In this 5 week course, you will learn how to identify and make a strong personal introduction. You will develop and demonstrate the speaking skills for group discussions: how to agree or disagree, how to clarify, restate and summarize. You will review and practice how to give information and respond to requests on the phone. You will study and role play effective interviewing. You will prepare and give a sales “pitch”, introducing a product or service. Throughout the course, you will adjust how you speak English and you will become more fluent and accurate when you speak. You will demonstrate culturally appropriate body language and tone. As you work through the course, you will complete self- and peer-evaluations. Through a combination of lectures, comprehension and vocabulary quizzes, practice and performance, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to communicate well in English, anywhere in the world.	
By the end of this course you will:
• Change how you speak English
•	Improve your pronunciation and fluency 
• Increase your English vocabulary 
•	Identify how culture influences your speech
•	Use culture to help you speak correctly 
•	Demonstrate the best body language for different cultural settings
•	Know statements, questions and responses for different settings and situations

title: Introduction to HTML, CSS, & JavaScript
description:
Want to take the first steps to become a Web Developer? This course will help you discover the languages, frameworks, and tools you will need to create interactive and engaging websites right from the beginning. 
You’ll begin by understanding the roles of front-end, back-end, and full-stack developers and how they collaborate, along with the terminology and skills essential for a web development career. 
Next, you’ll dive deep into HTML5—learning about structural elements like section, article, header, footer, and form controls such as input, fieldset, and legend. You’ll also explore the Document Object Model (DOM), scripting basics, and browser compatibility. 
Moving on to CSS, you’ll learn how to style and format web pages using selectors, IDs, and classes. You’ll explore layout tools like Flexbox and gain hands-on experience with responsive design using frameworks such as Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap. In JavaScript, you'll learn about variables, control structures, functions, prototypes, and how to interact with the DOM, along with practical experience using APIs and client-side scripting techniques to enhance user interaction. 
By learning the fundamentals of HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, you will be able to combine them to: 
 - Create the basic structure of a website 
 - Create format and layout for web applications 
 - Enhance your website and create rich, interactive applications 
 - Increase user interactivity and enhance user experience 
 - Give your website a real wow factor! 
Throughout the course, you'll apply your learning through numerous hands-on labs and conclude with a final project where you'll build a webpage to showcase your skills and strengthen your portfolio.

title: C for Everyone, Part 1: Programming Fundamentals
description:
This course is for everyone. In the new world we live in, coding is a universally valuable skill, whether you're a scientist, artist, or a humanist. Algorithms are everywhere, and we all have to understand how they work. The C language is particularly well suited as an introduction to coding: It's a tried-and-true language, and it allows you to understand computing processes at a deep level. 
This course is the first part of a two-course sequence. It is a hands-on introduction to programming in C, designed to guide learners step by step from the basics of syntax and data types to more advanced concepts such as control flow, functions, recursion, arrays, and pointers. Through video lessons, quizzes, programming exercises, and real debugging tasks, learners build foundational concepts and good coding practices. By the end, learners will be able to write clear C programs, debug effectively, and build the knowledge base needed for more advanced computer science and software development.

title: Scratch in Hindi
description:
आज की दुनिया में कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग की समझ एक महत्वपूर्ण कौशल बन गयी है. कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग, जिसको कोडिंग भी कहते हैं, नियोजनीयता बढ़ाने में भी साकारत्मक भूमिका निभाती है। कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग करने से logical thinking भी विकसित होती है. 

कुछ वर्षों पहले, अमेरिका की MIT यूनिवर्सिटी के MIT Media Lab ने बच्चों में कोडिंग की रूचि जागृत करने के लिए Scratch नाम की एक फ्री सॉफ्टवेयर बनाई थी. Scratch अब बहुत प्रचलित हो गयी है और करोड़ों बच्चे, अध्यापक और अभिभावक आज Scratch के users हैं. 

Scratch में बहुत सरल block-based programming के ज़रिये आप मस्त games, animation और interactive stories इत्यादि बना सकते हैं. Scratch के नए version 3.0 में कई नए advanced features भी हैं जैसे Artificial Intelligence. 

इस वीडियो श्रृंखला में आप सीखेंगे free software Scratch में प्रोग्रामिंग.

title: Car God Returns
description: Apni asli pehchaan se anjaan ek talented mechanic ki zindagi tab badal jaati hai jab uski girlfriend usse dhokha de deti hai aur ek powerful CEO usse contract marriage kar leti hai. Jab sach saamne aata hai ki wahi desh ke sabse bade automobile empire ka asli waaris aur legendary "Car God" hai, to use apna haq wapas paane aur apne dushmano ko unki aukaat dikhani hoti hai.

title: The Teen Queen
description: The Teen Queen is a youth college drama about identity, privilege, and class divide. When billionaire heiress Tanisha Merchant hides her identity to live as an ordinary student, a poor girl, Mahira, is mistaken for the real heiress and embraces the lie. As one girl gives up her wealth and the other steals it, a fierce rivalry unfolds, testing love, friendship, and the true meaning of worth. Watch now!

title: The Ancient Water Pot changed My Life
description: After being betrayed and thrown out of his family, a wealthy young man discovers his mother’s magical water pot connects him to Lata, a village girl living in 1975. Using knowledge from the future, they transform each other’s lives and fall in love across 51 years. But when their connection is destroyed, Sahil discovers that the love he was searching for may have been beside him all along.

title: Love Beneath Paris Skies
description: When a fiery billionaire heiress is forced to work with a rugged ex-army driver in Paris, their constant clashes turn into an unexpected romance. But as a ruthless family conspiracy, deadly attacks, and a shocking contract marriage threaten their lives and the Oberoi empire, they must decide whether to trust each other—or lose everything they love

title: Mission Admission
description: A billionaire father, Sudeep Sahani, disguises himself as a poor man to protect his daughter from humiliation in an elite school. As class prejudice, betrayal, and greed unfold, his ex-wife Anjana and her partner Tony try to exploit him. Sudeep exposes their truth, fights injustice, and challenges the system with his mission of equal education for all. Watch now.

title: Scientist Ki Waapsi
description: When a brilliant but humble scientist is falsely accused by a fame-hungry influencer, he must fight a ruthless social media trial, powerful enemies, and public humiliation to reclaim his name and complete a mission that could change India's future.

title: Dil Ka Encounter
description: Dil Ka Encounter follows Ishaan Raghuvanshi, a haunted ex-sniper, and Sara Khanna, a billionaire’s daughter turned cadet after a life-changing rescue. Under a hidden identity, Sara joins a Special Forces academy—only to meet Ishaan, now broken and in hiding. As deception, rivalry, and power games unfold, a dangerous bond forms between them. This isn’t just action—it’s a battle between love and duty, past and redemption. Will Ishaan rise again… or lose everything once more? Watch now!

title: The Return of the Ultimate Mom
description: Watch this show live on KuKuTV now!

title: Pyar ka Turbulence
description: A pregnant woman fights for her life on a turbulent flight—only to discover her pilot husband abandoning her for another woman. After losing her baby and being framed as a murderer, she rises from betrayal and heartbreak to reclaim her power… returning as a mysterious aviation titan determined to expose the lies that destroyed her life.

title: Oops, Not a Gold Digger [Hindi]
description:
A fearless delivery girl’s good deed spirals into an accidental marriage with a man she believes to be penniless—unaware he’s heir to a billionaire empire.
As family secrets, jealous rivals, and office politics threaten her dreams, she must fight for dignity, ambition, and love.
A tale of hidden identities, chaotic matchmaking, and an unexpected romance that could change her life forever.

title: Codename Pyaar
description: Ek low-profile genius AI engineer, jise sab bewda aur muftkhor samajhte hain, asal mein India ki self-drive car ka asli hero hai—and jab system uske bina collapse karta hai, tab sach aur jhoot ka sabse khatarnaak test shuru hota hai.

title: Boss Ishqq aur Deal
description: A divorced single mother, Isha, lies to become the PA of billionaire Karan Ahuja to save her daughter’s custody. What begins as hatred, ego clashes, and a reckless bet slowly turns into love. But conspiracies, betrayals, and deadly attacks threaten to destroy everything. Watch now.

title: Billionaire Doctor Ka Ishq
description: Manisha’s life is shattered when she discovers she is pregnant after being drugged and spending a night with a stranger. As fear and confusion give way to shocking truth, she learns the man involved is a powerful billionaire. Caught between trauma, secrecy, and social judgment, Manisha must navigate a world that questions her character while she struggles to reclaim control over her body, dignity, and future.

title: Beghar Billionaire
description: Armaan Raheja, a billionaire disguised as a beggar, and Kashish, a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch Now!

title: Time Travel [Hindi]
description: After betrayal and heartbreak, Rahul mysteriously travels back in time, determined to change his fate, save his family, and protect Alia from powerful enemies only to discover that altering the past comes with dangerous new consequences. Watch Now!

title: The Richest Bank Robber
description: When billionaire Adarsh Sharma returns to India, a sudden accident leaves his parents critically injured. Stripped of proof of identity, he is ridiculed and denied access to his own wealth. As time runs out, desperation turns into rebellion, forcing him into a daring heist of his own bank. Amid greed, ego, and injustice, the story unfolds as a gripping tale of survival, identity, and moral reckoning. Watch Now.

title: Desh ka Dhurandhar
description: Kabir, a fearless undercover operative known by his codename Agent Vajra, lives a double life defined by loyalty and sacrifice. When the President’s daughter is attacked by ruthless goons, Kabir steps in without hesitation, saving her in a high-risk rescue that exposes a larger conspiracy against the nation. At the same time, he is shattered by his wife’s betrayal—but even after discovering her deception, he refuses to let personal pain cloud his duty. When she is kidnapped by a terrorist from a hostile foreign country, Kabir risks everything to rescue her, proving that his sense of honor rises above heartbreak. In a gripping climax, he thwarts an assassination attempt on the President, dismantles the terror network, and emerges as a true patriot who places his country above all, earning the title of a selfless national hero.

title: Social Media ka Billionaire
description: A humble pizza delivery boy discovers he is the secret heir to an 8,000-crore empire but instead of revealing the truth, he chooses to stay poor and test the world that humiliated him.

title: CEO Bana Ghar Jamai
description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO.Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel.Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

title: Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions [Hindi]
description: "Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions" A wealthy young heir sets out to “audition” potential father figures to inherit his fortune. As eccentric candidates compete for the role, hidden motives, heartfelt bonds, and unexpected twists blur the line between family and fortune.

title: Oops, It Was My Husband [Hindi]
description: Three years after a contract marriage, ambitious designer Isha Shrivastava unexpectedly crosses paths with her estranged husband, billionaire Nitin Mehta the man she never really knew. What begins as a fake relationship to escape family debts spirals into real emotions, shocking secrets, and a second chance at love neither of them saw coming. Watch Now!

title: My Accidental Royal Husband [Hindi]
description: In a twist of fate, a common woman accidentally marries a royal heir, unaware of his true identity. As she navigates palace intrigue and royal duties, their bond deepens, leading her to discover unexpected love and power.

title: Crystal's Greatest Creation
description:
This story is a compelling exploration of hidden identities, love, and self-worth set against the backdrop of wealth and ambition. It challenges the idea of whether love can survive without truth and equality. The narrative follows two individuals who reject their powerful identities, only to rediscover themselves through each other.
Blending romance, drama, and high-stakes business conflict, the show presents a layered world of deception, family politics, and emotional transformation. At its core, it is a story of a woman’s journey from being an unseen force behind success to owning her power unapologetically.
With themes of betrayal, reinvention, and partnership, the show balances mass appeal with a modern, aspirational tone.

title: Just Divorced
description:
A poor but self-respecting girl discovers that her absentee father is a powerful billionaire who refuses to acknowledge her.
Public humiliation, betrayal, and emotional abandonment shatter her childhood belief in love and family.
As a mother-daughter duo walks away from injustice, fate begins to test the father with guilt, loss, and truth.
This is the story of broken promises, hidden identities, and a daughter who refuses to beg for her father’s love.

title: Brahmrakshas
description: When a wedding in the silent village of Dhumgarh breaks an ancient taboo against noise, a curse awakens—the vengeful spirit of Dev, a once-noble scholar betrayed in love and transformed into the dreaded Brahmrakshas. As brides mysteriously vanish, Ira, a fearless paranormal expert, arrives to uncover the truth.

title: Paralysed Dulha [Hindi]
description: Boss, Open Up Your Eyes is a high-stakes drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. When Swati is forced into a contract marriage with Abhinav, a powerful heir who wakes up from a coma, secrets begin to unravel—her true identity, his family’s ruthless motives, and a dangerous game of power. Between manipulation, revenge, and unexpected emotions, both must decide whether this marriage will destroy them or become their greatest strength.

title: My Commando Wife
description: A humiliated housewife, secretly a legendary Marine Commando presumed to be a myth, rises from betrayal and erasure to reclaim her identity, destroy the family that discarded her, and prove that the woman they broke is the very warrior they were never worthy of.

title: The Miracle Surgeon
description: A selfless man who sacrifices his legendary medical career to become a househusband for his wife and daughter is humiliated, cheated on, and brutally divorced only to lose custody of the child he raised as his own. Years later when he returns as India’s most celebrated surgeon, the very medical genius the world worships. Fate pits him against his past when the child he loved faces a life-or-death surgery—and the family who destroyed him must now beg the man they once crushed to save her life

title: Ruthra Thandavam
description: Ruthra Thandavam

title: Mafia's Innocent Bride [Tamil]
description:
Don David rules the dark underworld of Chennai. His word is law, his eyes spell death.

When Meera is pulled into his ruthless world, she faces blood, betrayal, and revenge at every turn.

The throne of power is up for grabs. The war has just begun. 🔥

Every moment a riddle. Every scene a shock. Witness it Now!

title: Me and My Sister [Tamil]
description: ஒரு போர்ல நல்லா அனுபவப்பட்ட ஒரு சோல்ஜர், ஒரு அழகான, பவர்ஃபுல் CEO-க்கு பர்சனல் பாடி கார்டா மாறறான். மறைஞ்சிருக்கும் ஆபத்துல இருந்து அவளைக் காப்பாத்துறான், அதே நேரம் பெரிய சதித்திட்டங்களையும் கண்டுபிடிக்கிறான். இந்த குழப்பத்துக்கு நடுவுல காதல் மலர, அவனோட பலமும் விசுவாசமும் கொடூரமான எதிரிகள், அப்புறம் கார்ப்பரேட் சதிக்கு எதிரா சோதிக்கப்படுது..அந்த சோதனையில இருந்து தப்பிச்சானா??

title: Battle of Billionaire  [Tamil]
description: Paarth Singh is the new MD of Singh Group but he has hidden his identity from everyone, even from his wife and in-laws. He visits them for his father in-law’s birthday celebration where they demean and insult him. Will he finally reveal his true identity during this crisis? Watch Now !

title: Rented Husband [Tamil]
description: Rented Husband

title: My Fiancé Is A Bigshot
description: Divya returns to Chennai hiding her true identity. Betrayed and publicly humiliated by her lover Guru, she is pushed to the edge. A chance encounter with Kishore, a powerful CEO fighting his own battles, changes everything. When Divya’s real strength is revealed, those who mocked her are left helpless. This is the rise of a true Lady Boss.

title: After divorce, my wife become a trillionaire [Tamil]
description: Time Travel and historical movie . After a bitter divorce, a man watches in shock as his ex-wife rises to become a trillionaire overnight. Now, the tables have turned—and so has the game of love, power, and regret.

title: Rocket Tycoon [Telugu]
description: A man learns a woman has last-stage lung cancer and needs treatment within three days. A misunderstanding makes her think he is the patient, leading her to panic over money, insult him, and end the relationship. After a time jump, a young scientist wins a major award, but a powerful businessman and his son disrupt the ceremony, forcing the man to intervene and assert his influence.

title: Tapasya vs Temptation [Telugu]
description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

title: The CEO Son-in-Law
description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO. Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel. Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

title: Mom is not Ugly [Telugu]
description: A self-sacrificing mother confronts her ungrateful son and his disdainful family, with help from the man she once saved, leading to a powerful lesson in humility and redemption.

title: The Prince [Kannada]
description: A billionaire in disguise marries a simple woman to discover the true meaning of love. But when her family’s doubts and a ruthless rival’s obsession threaten to tear them apart, he must fight harder than ever. A heartfelt saga of deception, loyalty, and the triumph of love over greed.

title: Love Mocktail
description: Aditya’s life shatters when his girlfriend leaves him on their wedding day for a richer man. In a twist of fate, he impulsively marries Preeti Shetty, a strong and mysterious woman. What begins as a sudden marriage turns into a journey of love, betrayal, and destiny. As secrets unfold, Aditya discovers he is actually Siddharth Sharma, the lost heir of a powerful family, leading to a battle for identity, love, and legacy.

title: Tapasya vs Temptation [Kannada]
description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

title: Youngest Secret Billionaire [Kannada]
description: A struggling youngster, dismissed by society, dares to dream beyond limits. Through relentless hustle, bold risks, and defying betrayals, he transforms his failures into steppingstones. Against all odds, he rises from anonymity to shocking the world as the youngest secret billionaire, a tale of grit, ambition, and destiny fulfilled. Watch now.

title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [Hindi]
description: Reborn as nobility with the power to size up talent in a glance, Ars Louvent is on a mission to elevate his new life.

title: PSYЯEN [Hindi]
description: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya-who possessed the same card-suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as "Psyren." When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins-one that will change his fate forever.

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN [Hindi]
description:
A boy fights... for "the right death."

Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.

Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with the Double-Faced Specter. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojou Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo Metropolitan Technical High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode received an early web premiere on September 19th, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 3rd, 2020.

title: A Gesture and a Word
description: At age 50, musician and poet, Rob Morsberger was diagnosed with terminal brain cancer - and it came at the high point in his career. After 25 years in the music business, critics were starting to compare his songwriting to Randy Newman, Tom Waits and even Stephen Foster. Finally, it was all starting to come together. Rather than succumb to the shockingly grim news that he had 18 to 20 months to live, Rob used it as fuel to launch into the most prolific period of his songwriting career - determined to utilize whatever remained of this physical and spiritual resources to explore through words and music the nature of life, the inevitability of death and the infinite magic in the detail of a single moment. This musical legacy was for all to hear but it was especially for his 8 year old son so he could know and remember his father. "A Gesture and a Word" is a gentle portrait of the greatest songwriter you never heard of - a man who exemplified the phrase, Ars Longa - Vita Brevis (Art is Long - Life is Short).
